summary: Jalving is a family-owned potato breeding company in Wezup, Drenthe, Netherlands, working on varieties with Phytophthora resistance and on niche types. It sells seed potatoes in small packs to gardeners and allotment associations, and table potatoes to private customers, restaurants and caterers. Gezinus and Aaltje Jalving founded it in 1981.
products: Breeding of new potato varieties with Phytophthora resistance
Seed potatoes in 1, 3 and 5 kg packs for gardeners
Seed potatoes suited to organic growing
Table potatoes for private customers, restaurants and caterers
Company visits with breeding demonstrations and tastings
markets: Netherlands: allotment gardeners and allotment associations
Netherlands: private customers, restaurants and caterers
United Kingdom: English market served from the Shropshire site
facts: Founded in 1981 by Gezinus and Aaltje Jalving, first based in Den Andel, North Groningen
Second site set up in 2006 in Shropshire, near Birmingham
Seed potato business sold in 2009; breeding became the only focus
Trial field holds about 30,000 different seedlings, according to the company
Seed packs: 1 kg EUR 4.00, 3 kg EUR 12.00, 5 kg EUR 18.00 (Alouette and Twister)
limitations: Staff numbers, hectares, tonnes, seed generations and certification classes are not published on the pages read.
The website does not state Jalving's exact role in breeding the Agrico varieties it sells, and parts of it are out of date (newest news post from 2018).
